rationale: v1.80.1 already provides device alignment guides, icon/LED replacement and unfinished device placement previews. This fixes invisible references and interrupted-drag rollback for those existing stable behaviours. The additional Walls line only exposes the winning endpoint from #885 introduced within this cycle; that intermediate polish is not a separate stable-release feature.

summary.ru: Направляющие учитывают видимые значки, а уход со страницы безопасно отменяет незавершённое перемещение.
summary.en: Guides use visible icons, and leaving a page safely cancels unfinished marker moves.
